scheme_name: Burial and Ex-gratia Payment Scheme in Case of Death of Unregistered Laborer During Work at Construction Site
other_conditions: The deceased worker must be registered with the Madhya Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MPBOCWWB).
The deceased worker must have held an active regular membership.
The deceased worker must possess a valid identity card.
Only the legal heir or dependent family member of the deceased registered worker is eligible to apply.
The application must be submitted within 6 months of the accident or death.
The application must be submitted within any prescribed period, if applicable.
benefits_summary: Provides ₹3,000 funeral assistance and an ex‑gratia payment of ₹4,00,000 on death or ₹2,00,000 on permanent disability for eligible construction laborers.
